writing.overall_comment: The skill has strong conceptual coverage but needs corrected, edge-case-aware examples and a more executable process to be reliably actionable.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name, description, and body consistently cover design patterns, SOLID principles, architectural patterns, and code smells, though the sparse 'Core Competencies' section underrepresents the referenced depth.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: Examples are illustrative but the Repository implementation omits required findAll and delete methods and no examples cover failure paths or edge cases.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: The checklist and pattern-selection guide help, but the document lacks an explicit step-by-step workflow for selecting, applying, or reviewing patterns and provides no fallback guidance when no pattern fits.

suggestions: In the Repository implementation example, add the required findAll and delete methods so it fully matches the pattern's contract.
Add examples that cover failure paths and edge cases, such as empty query results or missing-record behavior, to the Repository example and related pattern guidance.
Add an explicit step-by-step workflow for selecting, applying, and reviewing patterns—including fallback guidance when no pattern fits—to the pattern-selection guide or checklist.
